0022600132.text: Atlanta enters at 2-2 and on a two-game losing streak, sitting 2nd in the Southeast, one game back, and 7th in the East, while Miami is 0-4, on a four-game losing streak, 5th in the Southeast, and 15th in the East. The Hawks are 0-1 at home this season and are missing Henri Veesaar (out, knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture), with Aaron Wiggins day-to-day with a knee bruise and a game-time decision, while Miami will be without Simone Fontecchio (out, illness). The teams have not met yet this season, and their last meeting was a 143-117 Miami win on April 12, in Miami, part of a 2025-26 season series the Hawks lost 1-3.
